name: Anyo Balfourme
source: Born into a noble family. Being the only child in the family, her father has been overly protective of her. Because of that, she hardly has any friends, except for her nana and the maids, and the occasional two boys (Leonel & Lance) that comes by out of no where. Up till now, she has been home studied by the demand of her father, forced to exceed into the study of law. Wanting to get out of the mansion and get out to the world outside, she requested to go to school like other children. She finally manages to get her father's permission and enrolls into Antique Ivy.
